title: Heel, flat, ball, toe
note: A plain walk across the bay. Every contact should read heel first, then flat, then the heel peeling up onto the ball, then the toe pushing off. The feet face the way the body travels.

title: Opening a letter
note: Thumb under the flap, a tear along the top, the sheet drawn out and unfolded. The left hand holds the envelope the whole time; the right hand goes to its handles.

title: A hand on the shoulder
note: Shim passes behind Bola and rests a hand on her left shoulder for a moment, then goes. The hand has to land on the shoulder and ride it while she breathes.

title: The hug

title: Handshake

title: Sitting down, standing up
note: The weight has to travel from the feet to the seat and back. To stand, the nose goes over the toes before the hips leave the chair.

title: Tiptoe past a sleeper
note: Bola crosses on the balls of her feet, heels never down, strides short. Dot sleeps on the bench. The test: the ball stays planted while the heel is up, and no frame puts weight on a heel.

title: Stamping in a temper
note: Each stamp: the weight moves over the standing foot first, the knee comes up, the foot is driven down flat and the body sinks through it. The planted foot must not move.

note: The front foot stays flat, the back knee goes to the floor and the toes of the back foot curl under. The knee touching the floor becomes part of the support.

title: A coin on the floor
note: Seeing it, stopping, squatting with a straight back, picking it up between finger and thumb. A squat keeps the heels down; the knees go forward over the toes and the hips go back.

title: Running, then a skid
note: A run has a flight phase: both feet off the floor between steps. Then both heels are planted and the skid is allowed to slide; the body leans back against it and the arms windmill. Dot was in the way.

title: Tipping the hat
note: The hat lives on the head, passes to the hand by the brim, is raised and tilted, and goes back to the head. Each change of owner happens with the hand already at the brim, so the hat never jumps.

title: Blowing out a candle
note: Hands behind the back, so the neck does the work: it reaches forward and lengthens, the cheeks fill, and the flame goes. The neck stretch is drawn with rings so the extra length can be seen.

title: Opening an umbrella
note: The right hand holds the crook; the left hand finds the runner on the shaft and pushes it up, and the canopy opens as far as the runner has travelled. Then it goes up over the head and spins.

title: Doing up a button
note: Small work at the chest: two pinching hands a few centimetres apart, the chin tucked so the eyes can see. The forearms come close and the clash check watches that they do not pass through each other.

title: Catching a ball
note: Shim throws underarm; the ball flies a parabola. Bola's hands do not wait for it at a fixed point: they are sent to the ball itself and meet it at the moment it arrives, then give with it.

title: Carrying a full plate
note: Both hands under the plate, steps short and soft, eyes on the pie. The right hand carries the plate; the left hand is sent to the plate, so it rides along wherever the right hand goes.

title: Writing a letter
note: Seated, the left hand flat on the paper as a brace, the right hand driving the pen along lines. The pen tip has to stay on the paper; the hand height is fixed by it.

title: Wiping the table
note: A routine: three slow circles and a straight sweep to the edge, the left hand braced on the table and carrying some of the weight. The cloth stays flat on the surface throughout.

title: Smelling a flower
note: The flower is lifted to the nose and the nose does not go down to meet it. The breath in is slow and the chest rises; the breath out drops the shoulders.

title: Throwing overarm

title: Sweeping
note: Two hands on one shaft, the top hand steering and the lower hand pushing. The broom is moved and both hands are sent to points on its handle, so they always grip the same stick.

title: Dropping the keys
note: The keys come out of the pocket and slip. They fall under gravity; the left hand is sent to the falling keys and catches them before the floor. The catch frame is checked for contact error like any ot

title: Recognised by the hand
note: He holds out a hand; she takes it in both of hers to press a coin into it, and the touch tells her who he is. Her hands are sent to his wrist, so they stay on it when he trembles.

title: Fingertips
note: Two index fingers approach one point and stop when the tips meet. The wrists are sent to points one finger-length short of each other, so the touch happens at the fingertips and not inside the hands.

title: Wiping a tear
note: Shim's thumb goes to Bola's cheek and draws the tear away. The target is a point on her face, so when she tilts her head into his hand the hand moves with it.

title: Leading a child by the hand
note: Two walks of different scale kept in step: Dot takes more steps to cover the same ground. Her hand is sent to Bola's wrist and rides it, arm swing and all.

title: A pat on the head
note: The big hand comes down on the small head three times; each pat compresses Dot's neck a little and she screws up her eyes. The hand is sent to the top of her head and so follows it down.

title: A tap on the wrong shoulder
note: Bola reaches behind Shim to tap his far shoulder and ducks the other way. The tapping arm crosses behind his back. He turns to the side he was tapped on and finds nobody.

title: Slow dance
note: Four hands on two bodies: hers on his shoulders, his at her waist. They sway together, weight from one foot to the other, both keyed on the same frames so neither leads the other off balance.

title: Helping someone up

title: The letter changes hands
note: For a moment the letter has two hands on it. It is owned by one hand at a time; the other hand is sent to the letter and so goes wherever it is pulled. Bola does not quite let go.

title: Straightening a collar

title: High five, low five
note: The high five succeeds: two hands sent to one point. The low five is the old joke: Shim offers a palm and takes it away, and Bola's hand arrives at the empty place where it was.

title: A kiss on the forehead
note: The tall one bends to the small one: knees, hips and neck all give some of the distance, and the neck lengthens to finish it. Her face tips up to meet him.

title: Arm wrestling
note: Seated across a table, right elbows down, right hands locked at one point. The grip trembles, holds, and goes over; the loser's hand is pressed to the table. Both left hands brace flat on the table.

title: A shove
note: Two flat hands land on the chest and push. Bola goes backwards and has to step twice to catch her weight, arms out. The stumble is the point, so a short loss of balance is declared.

title: Two bows
note: The bow hinges at the hips with the back and neck in one line; the hands slide down the thighs toward the knees. Shim bows a little deeper and a little longer, and Bola answers with a second bow.

title: Walking past without a look
note: She walks the whole width of the bay and never turns her head. His head follows her the whole way: past the limit of the neck the turn goes on into the spine, then he gives up and looks down.

title: The Tramp's walk

title: Alas, poor Yorick
note: The skull is held out at eye level on a flat palm and looked at; the other hand rests on the hip with the elbow out. Almost nothing moves except the head and the eyes, which is the test: small things

title: Arms up at the top of the steps
note: Up on the crate, fists high, bouncing on the balls of the feet. Each bounce rolls both feet onto the ball and the body rises over them; the heels come down between bounces.

title: At the bow of the ship
note: She stands with arms spread and eyes closed; he stands behind with his hands at her waist. His hands are sent to her body, so they stay at her waist while she leans into the wind.

title: The Thinker

title: Waving goodbye
note: A big wave on tiptoe and a smaller one back over the shoulder from someone walking away. Shim's wave is an overlay track on top of his walk, so his legs keep walking while his arm waves.

title: Facepalm
note: The hand meets the face and the head drops into the hand at the same moment. The target is a point in front of the face, so as the head nods the hand rides down with it, then drags down the face.

title: Shh
note: One finger to the lips, eyes wide, a look at the sleeper, then a retreat on tiptoe. The finger is the target, the rest of the hand follows.

title: The salute
note: Heels together with the toes turned out, chin up, then the right hand cuts up to the brow with the elbow out to the side, holds, and snaps down. All the joints arrive together.

title: A shrug
note: Shoulders up, elbows in, palms turned up and out, the head tipped and the mouth pulled down. Six joint groups move together for a fifth of a second and then all let go.

title: Holding it in
note: Fists, rigid arms, shoulders climbing, the face going red, and a tremor everywhere. Then one long breath out and every joint drops. Muscle bulges are drawn from the effort value.

title: The sigh
note: A slow rise of the chest and shoulders, then a fall that goes further than where it started: shoulders below rest, spine bent, head down, knees soft. Nothing else happens.

title: The double take
note: A glance at something impossible, a look away, two more steps, then the head snaps back so fast the neck stretches to catch up and the eyes pop. Dot is floating.

title: Nodding off
note: On a bench, the head sinks slowly as the neck goes slack, then jerks up, the neck snapping long. Twice; the third time it stays down.

title: Swinging on a lamppost
note: One hand on the post, one foot near its base, the body swung out and away. The hand on the post carries her, which the weight check cannot see from the feet alone, so the lean is declared.

title: The wall that is not there
note: Flat palms on an invisible wall. One hand stays exactly where it is while the other moves; the stillness of the planted hand is the illusion, and the contact check measures it.

title: Leaning on the rail
note: Forearms on the rail, weight forward onto them, one foot crossed behind the other on its toe. The crossed foot is meant and declared; the hands on the rail are counted as support.

title: Leaping a puddle

title: Peeking round the corner
note: Hidden behind the wall, she leans out sideways: the spine bends, the neck bends further and stretches, and only the head clears the edge. When Dot looks her way it all snaps back.

note: Two hands on the rope, one above the other. She hangs her weight on it and the bell turns; the rope then lifts her onto her toes. The hands are sent to the rope, so they ride its arc.

note: Shim's keys are Bola's keys reflected through the empty frame: left and right swapped, every sideways quantity negated. One gesture is deliberately four frames late, and you can see it in the strip.

title: 1 So · Solid perception
note: Everything happens around Bola. Shim walks up to greet her, Dot crosses in front of her, and at the end both circle her while she stands at the centre.

title: 2 Lq · Liquid perception
note: Three crossings in one place. Bola walks in, Shim passes her and walks on, Dot leaves as Shim reaches her. Each is central only until the next one takes over.

title: 3 Ga · Gaseous perception
note: A bouncing ball, a clock running, a kite on a line, rain, steam from a cup and Bola walking a slow circle: one image among the others.

title: 4 Ic · Icon
note: Bola sits facing a candle we never see. Her face passes from calm to wonder, holds, then moves through unease toward resolve without standing up.

title: 5 Dv · Dividual
note: Fourteen dummies in three rows look up at a light. Surprise passes through the crowd from left to right, then every arm goes up together. Dot, front and centre, carries it.

title: 6 As · Any-space-whatever
note: Night, rain and wind in an emptied bay: a lamp, a puddle, a chair on its side, a hat on the floor. Shim walks out at the start and the place stays; the film only uses the part after he has gone.

title: 7 Sy · Symptom
note: Shim creeps up to a pie on a crate in a crouch, freezes, lunges, and eats with his face in it. When Bola moves he turns his head and bares his teeth.

title: 8 Fe · Fetish
note: A skull on a crate under a light. Dot comes up to it, reaches, and stops a few centimetres short with her hand trembling. She backs away without touching it.

title: 9 Or · Originary world
note: A flooded bay with a skull on a post, a broken fence and a pole stuck in the mud. Shim wades in from the left, slows, and stops waist-deep with his head down.

title: 10 Il · Index of lack
note: A room in disorder: a chair down, a cup on the floor, a crate that twitches. Bola searches, lifts the crate and finds Dot hiding under it. She sets the crate aside and offers her hand.

title: 11 Ie · Index of equivocity · a
note: Shim gives Bola a letter. She reads it and presses it to her chest with her eyes shut. In one version Dot, behind, is delighted; in the other she is horrified. The gesture is identical in both.

title: 11 Ie · Index of equivocity · b
note: Shim gives Bola a letter. She reads it and presses it to her chest with her eyes shut. In one version Dot, behind, is delighted; in the other she is horrified. The gesture is identical in both.

title: 12 Ve · Vector
note: Bola leaves a key on a crate and goes. Shim finds it, opens a door with it and goes through. Dot, behind the door, walks out to the crate. Each thread leaves a gap the next one fills.

title: 13 Mi · Milieu
note: A small town in the bay: steps, a fence, a lamp, a door and a bench. A sweeper, a traveller with a suitcase, two people on the bench, a reader under the lamp and a doorkeeper each do their part.

title: 14 Bi · Binomial
note: Bola and Shim start at opposite ends of a line drawn on the floor, fists up, and advance in turns. They meet at the line and push palm to palm.

title: 15 Im · Imprint
note: Bola sits on a bench holding a cup in both hands. People pass close in front of her, the clock runs faster, rain starts. She grips tighter and tighter, then stands and throws the cup down.

title: 16 Pl · Plastic figure
note: Bola and Shim argue across a table. She raises her hand. Off screen the table is shoved, the cup slides off and breaks, the candle goes out. Afterwards Shim is gone and Bola sits alone.

title: 17 Th · Theatrical figure
note: On a stage before one spectator, Bola and Shim play a fight twice with no contact. Then they stand face to face in earnest anger, and instead of fighting they turn and bow.

title: 18 Ma · Mise en abyme
note: Dot sits watching a screen. Bola stands behind her; later Shim comes in and leans to look. The screen shows the room they are in.

title: 19 Su · Figure of the sublime
note: A puddle no wider than a stride lies in Dot's way. Over it stands a stepped pyramid. She climbs it with total solemnity, raises her arms at the top, and comes down the other side. Declared: on the way

title: 20 En · Figure of enfeeblement
note: Bola walks a long way slowly, stops, sags, looks around, and walks part of the way back even more slowly. Nothing she does changes anything; she pushes a crate three times and it does not move.

title: 21 Qu · Quotidian
note: Shim, at a table, picks up a cup, drinks, puts it down, rests his hand, looks out of the window and sighs. The light goes from morning to evening while he does it.

title: 22 Ll · Limit of the large form
note: Bola and Shim square up to fight. Bola stops, looks at her own fists, then at him, and lowers them. He lowers his. She holds out an open hand instead.

title: 23 Ls · Limit of the small form
note: Dot pushes a ball along a zigzag; Shim carries a cup on a long loop. Both cross the same chalk mark, half a minute apart in their own lines, and never notice each other.

title: 24 Xl · Extreme limit · a
note: Bola walks to a box on a table. In one version she lifts it and finds nothing under it; in the other she stops and stares and never touches it.

title: 24 Xl · Extreme limit · b
note: Bola walks to a box on a table. In one version she lifts it and finds nothing under it; in the other she stops and stares and never touches it.

title: 25 Rd · Rich dream · waking
note: Bola dozes on a bench, falls asleep, and wakes with a start.

title: 25 Rd · Rich dream · the dream
note: Inside the dream Bola floats and turns slowly with her arms out; Shim and Dot drift round her; clocks spin and a kite and a hat float past. Declared: no one here is standing on anything.

title: 26 Rs · Restrained dream · waking
note: Bola sits at a table, drinks from a cup and puts it back. The clock runs forwards.

title: 26 Rs · Restrained dream · dream
note: Identical to the waking version until she puts the cup down: it stays in the air where she let go, and the clock runs backwards.

title: 27 Mw · Movement of world
note: Bola, Shim, Dot and two extras sway and lift their arms on the same beat; the lamp swings, a ball bounces, two chairs slide, the clock jumps a step per beat. Nobody starts it and nobody watches it.

title: 28 Sd · Strong destiny · the past
note: Bola walks with a cup. Shim runs past from behind, knocks her shoulder, and the cup falls and breaks. He does not stop. Declared: the knock is a body contact by design.

title: 28 Sd · Strong destiny · the present
note: Bola stands over the broken cup. After a long look she turns, walks to Shim and points at him. He steps back.

title: 29 Wd · Weak destiny · waiting
note: Dot sits on a bench next to a suitcase, swinging her feet and looking at a door that does not open.

title: 29 Wd · Weak destiny · fragments
note: At a door, Bola gives Shim a letter and turns away. We never see him open it.

title: 30 Fp · Forking paths · the fork
note: Bola walks up a chalk line to where it splits, stops, and looks down each branch.

title: 30 Fp · Forking paths · the fork again
note: The same walk to the fork, but now Bola wears a hat she did not have before.

title: 30 Fp · Forking paths · left branch
note: From the fork Bola takes the left branch to where Shim waits, and they shake hands.

title: 30 Fp · Forking paths · right branch
note: From the fork Bola takes the right branch and meets herself: her double stands there and points back the way she came.

title: 30 Fp · Forking paths · back to the fork
note: From the right branch Bola walks back to the fork and stops there again.

title: 31 Mk · Mark
note: Bola, then Shim, then Dot: each walks up to the table, drops a coin in the cup and rings the bell, the same way each time.

title: 32 Dm · Demark
note: The same series of three. Then a fourth comes up to the table: Bola again, while Bola is still standing at the side where she finished. Everyone turns to look.

title: 33 Sb · Symbol
note: A key passes through every relation in the scene: Bola gives it to Shim, Shim locks a door with it, Dot snatches it, Dot sets it on a table under a lamp, and all three stand round it.

title: 34a Op · Opsign
note: Shim sits facing a window with rain on it. He blinks and breathes. Nothing else happens, and he does nothing about it.

title: 34b Sn · Sonsign
note: Dot walks a few steps and stops mid-stride with her head turned, listening.

title: 35 Mf · Mirrors face to face
note: Bola stands between two facing mirrors, turns slowly and raises an arm. The reflections repeat into the distance; the copies lag, and one mirror runs further behind than the other.

title: 36 Lo · Limpid and opaque · rehearsal
note: Shim rehearses a gesture with the script in his left hand: arm out, bow, hand to the heart.

title: 36 Lo · Limpid and opaque · performance
note: Shim performs the gesture in a hat, without the script.

title: 37 Se · Seed and environment · the world
note: Bola and Shim walk round a lamp in the rain; on a table in the middle stands a glass globe.

title: 37 Se · Seed and environment · the seed
note: Dot stands at a table and looks into a glass globe.

title: 38 Pp · Peaks of the present · taken
note: Bola holds out a cup; Shim takes it and smiles.

title: 38 Pp · Peaks of the present · dropped
note: Bola holds out a cup; Shim does not take it, and it falls and breaks.

title: 39 Sp · Sheets of the past
note: Three rooms side by side. In the first Dot bounces a ball; in the second Bola sways to music; in the third a stooped Bola walks with a stick. All three happen at once. Declared: the old Bola is off ba

title: 40 Pf · Powers of the false · Shim
note: A testimony to camera: hand to the chest, an open palm, a raised finger, a shake of the head, both hands open. The same gestures, frame for frame, in three bodies.

title: 40 Pf · Powers of the false · Dot
note: A testimony to camera: hand to the chest, an open palm, a raised finger, a shake of the head, both hands open. The same gestures, frame for frame, in three bodies.

title: 40 Pf · Powers of the false · Bola
note: A testimony to camera: hand to the chest, an open palm, a raised finger, a shake of the head, both hands open. The same gestures, frame for frame, in three bodies.

title: 41 Ba · Bodies of attitude
note: Three bodies waiting: Bola slumped on a bench, Shim leaning on a rail with one foot crossed, Dot standing and fidgeting, then yawning and stretching. Nobody is about to do anything.

title: 42 Bg · Bodies of gest
note: An office ritual. Three grey clerks come to a table one by one; each bows, Bola stamps once, each bows again and leaves. Then she goes on stamping with nobody there.

title: 43 Br · Cinema of the brain
note: The floor is a chalk diagram. Lines draw themselves between labelled nodes and the three walk along them; each node lights when someone reaches it.
